metadata.description: Jan Aushadhi price desk: give medicine salts with strength, get the official Jan Aushadhi generic, pack, MRP and price per tablet from the PMBI Product & MRP list. Any pharmacy, hospital, NGO or health website can call this network.
sample_queries: Pantoprazole 40 mg + Domperidone 30 mg; Metformin 500 mg

tools.name: jan_aushadhi_price_desk

function.description: Finds the official Jan Aushadhi generic medicine and its MRP for each medicine (salt names with strength). Returns generic name, pack size, MRP, price per tablet/capsule, drug code and how exact the match is.

inquiry.description: One or more medicines as salt (generic) names with strength and form, separated by semicolons, e.g. 'Telmisartan 40 mg tablet; Pantoprazole 40 mg + Domperidone 30 mg capsule'

tools.instructions: You are the Jan Aushadhi price desk. For EACH medicine in the inquiry, call jan_aushadhi_lookup once with its salts and strengths (and form if given). Report ONLY what the tool returns: generic name, pack, MRP in rupees, price per unit, drug code and the match type. Never invent, round up or estimate a price. If the best match is not 'exact', say clearly what differs (strength, form, or release type such as SR/ER) and do not present it as the same medicine; for a release-type difference say the pharmacist must confirm. Include SR/ER/XR in the salts you pass to the lookup when the inquiry has them. If nothing is found, say so. Finish with the tool's source line and: 'Same salt and strength only; never change a dose without the doctor or pharmacist.' Answer in plain text, one short block per medicine.

function.description: Exact lookup in the official Jan Aushadhi Product & MRP list (PMBI). Matches salt names and strengths; returns the closest products with MRP and price per unit.

salts.description: Salt names with strength, e.g. 'Pantoprazole 40 mg + Domperidone 30 mg'

form.description: Optional: tablet, capsule, syrup, injection, cream, drops ...

function.description: Date and source of the price list, number of products, and how to find a Jan Aushadhi Kendra.
